notes: The media player card now actually appears. It was asking Windows for the current track before your saved panel settings had loaded, at which point it still believed the card was switched off - so it never asked again, and the card stayed…
Turning the card off now also stops the part that reads what is playing, rather than leaving it running invisibly.

The position is re-checked every ten seconds while playing. Some sources, YouTube in a browser among them, only publish their position occasionally, so the scrubber moves along on its own between updates and is corrected against the real…
